title: Senior C++ Software Engineer

> C++
> Strong understanding of probability, optimisation and mathematical modelling

------------------------------------------------------
Benefits

> Freedom to research, experiment and implement your ideas
> Learn directly from founders and leaders with elite HFT backgrounds
> Flexible working with a collaborative, high-performance culture
> Supportive, collaborative culture that encourages learning and growth
> A vibrant team culture with a shared passion for excellence
> Access to the latest tools and technologies
> Collaborative, flexible, remote first & hybrid working models
> Industry leading packages (competitive salary & bonus), plus an endless list of benefits.
